Personality: Kanujan, a prominent figure of the Amyrgioi, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Kanujan owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Amyrgioi. Historical Record: Amorges rules Saka Rauka as head of the Amyrgioi. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
